description: This Java class 'BasePage' provides a base object for page interactions in Selenium WebDriver tests for the OrangeHRM application. It includes utility methods for waiting, clicking, typing, navigating, handling dynamic content, and UI components specific to the application's OXD elements, with focus on robustness and reusability.

classes.name: BasePage
classes.description: A foundational page object providing common WebDriver utilities such as waiting, clicking, input handling, navigation, and interactions with specific OXD components for testing the OrangeHRM web application.

methods.name: getExplicitWaitSeconds
methods.description: Lazily retrieves the explicit wait timeout setting to avoid class initialization order issues.

methods.name: getWait
methods.description: Creates a WebDriverWait with a specified timeout.

methods.name: getWait
methods.description: Creates a WebDriverWait with the default configured timeout.

methods.name: getFluentWait
methods.description: Creates a FluentWait that ignores NoSuchElementException and StaleElementReferenceException for robustness.

methods.name: retryOnStale
methods.description: Executes a Supplier action with retries upon encountering StaleElementReferenceException, critical for dynamic page stability.

methods.name: navigateTo
methods.description: Builds a URL relative to the base URL and navigates the browser to it.

methods.name: navigateToAbsolute
methods.description: Navigates the browser directly to a given absolute URL.

methods.name: waitForVisible
methods.description: Waits until the specified element is visible on the page.

methods.name: waitForVisible
methods.description: Waits until the specified element is visible, with custom timeout.

methods.name: waitForClickable
methods.description: Waits until the specified element is clickable.

methods.name: waitForAllVisible
methods.description: Waits until all elements matching the locator are visible.

methods.name: waitForPresence
methods.description: Waits until the element is present in the DOM, regardless of visibility.

methods.name: isElementDisplayed
methods.description: Checks if an element is displayed on the page without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: isElementVisible
methods.description: Checks if an element is visible within a specific timeout.

methods.name: clearAndType
methods.description: Clears an input field and types text, retrying on stale element exceptions.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks an element after waiting for it to be clickable, with retries for dynamic DOM updates.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves trimmed text content from an element.

methods.name: getCurrentUrl
methods.description: Gets the current browser URL.

methods.name: waitForUrlContains
methods.description: Waits until the URL contains the specified fragment.

methods.name: findOxdInputByLabel
methods.description: Finds an input element within an OXD input group by label text, with handling for dynamic page updates.

methods.name: getInputValidationError
methods.description: Gets validation error message for an input group, waiting for the message to appear.

methods.name: waitForValidationError
methods.description: Waits for a specific validation error message to appear within a timeout, polling periodically.

methods.name: clickButtonByText
methods.description: Clicks a button identified by visible text, with fallback XPath search.

methods.name: waitForToast
methods.description: Waits for a toast notification of a given type with specific message content.

methods.name: waitForPageLoad
methods.description: Waits for the page layout context to be visible, indicating load completion.

methods.name: takeScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot as a byte array for reporting purposes.
